json_schema.description: A goal is cancelled by CLOSING it, never by deleting or mutating it — so cancelled work stays visible in the log with a reason attached. A redirect is a cancel plus a new goal, never an edit. Transitivity to open children is the engine's job at emit time: this type records one cancellation, and cascading it would need the appender to discover children, which is a read the append transaction must not take. Distinct from goal_closed because outcome=aborted on a result an agent produced and a cancellation nobody worked are different facts, and collapsing them makes eval data lie. NOT spillable (contract event).
